objective: Make the resident native market publish a canonical, price-level-only order book derived inside the real MPC, fetchable without corporate keys or market journal access. Bind the book to the signed MPC result and expose new post-trade depth only after canonical settlement and all node finality confirmations.
truth_provider: Seven real MPC outputs and signed receipts, actual resident market progress, network-fetched public snapshots, threshold zkPI, five native DeFMI validators and process restart readback.
hard_constraints: No plaintext order sorting or aggregating at coordinator/frontend. Use the pinned official MP-SPDZ oblivious sorting implementation; secret aggregation merges equal-side equal-price remaining quantities before revealing fixed-shape canonical levels.

Run sell30@101, sell30@100, sell60@100 in that sequence and then buy75@101 IOC. Fund all three sells from the same120-unit facility. Publish level snapshots [101:30], [100:30,101:30], [100:90,101:30], then [100:15,101:30] only after two atomic fills at100 for75 units, notional7500,14 canonical observations and zero post-match financial signatures.

Actual process exit75 after canonical acceptance and before local completion must leave the network book at the previous90@100 plus30@101 view. Restart must recover exact signed settlement and publish the15@100 plus30@101 view once without another trade. Completed service replacement and validator restart must preserve the final snapshot.

Public output contains canonical price levels, publication sequence, result binding and finality provenance, never per-order quantities, participant identifiers, reservation authorities, private-state data or source-slot grouping. Reject malformed, duplicated, out-of-order, noncanonical or unsigned depth rather than substitute empty/fabricated data.
Build/test/Docker only on Softbank or Omen; bind exact runtime source and result hashes. Do not publish private runtime.
non_claims: One-host bounded-book functional smoke, not performance/economic/WAN/independent-operator or cryptographic promotion.

Lifecycle automation, full authenticated transaction API and ReactFlow cutover, anonymous transport, unrelated facility writers, mid-proof/stale-plan recovery and old-state rolling upgrades remain explicit work.
Public exact price-level depth necessarily leaks market information; this is not differential privacy or order-existence secrecy.
